## What to build

Query-shaping filters and scan honesty for `retrieve`. Filters: day window (`--from`/`--to`), timestamp bounds (`--since`/`--until`), provider include and exclude (`--source`/`--exclude-source`, repeatable), `--type article|live-update`, `--tag`. Date filtering uses each chunk's own `published_at` (live posts have per-post timestamps, so a multi-day live blog windows by post, not by parent article date), falling back to the article timestamp.

Every response attaches the per-provider `coverage` block (scanned, complete, incomplete with per-date status, gaps) so an empty result is interpretable: "we failed to acquire" is distinguishable from "nothing was published". Retrieval never triggers scanning (ADR-0009).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each filter provably narrows results, with per-filter tests plus live spot checks on the scratch corpus
- [ ] A multi-day live blog windows by post timestamp: a query bounded to day 2 returns only day-2 posts of a blog that started day 1
- [ ] A day with failed scans surfaces those providers under `incomplete` with their status, live-verified
- [ ] Filters echo back in the response envelope
- [ ] SKILL.md documents filters and coverage interpretation in the same change; suite and typecheck green
